# How Far Must You Pull?

<!-- STEP id="sounds-simple" -->
Lifting the box 1 metre sounds like it should take 1 metre of string.

It doesn't.

<!-- STEP id="both-shorten" -->
## Both Segments Shorten

Both string segments support the box.

Lift it by 1 metre, and BOTH segments must each shorten by 1 metre.

<!-- STEP id="total-pulled" -->
## Add Them Up

That's 2 metres of string pulled in at your hand, total — for the box to rise just 1 metre.

<!-- STEP id="the-trade" -->
## The Trade

**Half the force, but twice the distance. You never get something for nothing.**
